dedupe_keys.name: регистър на издадените разрешения за таксиметров превоз на пътници

description: Регистър на издадените разрешения за таксиметров превоз на пътници is a dataset listed in Open Data Bulgaria, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ирина Искрова. Register of authorisations issued by the municipality of Belovo to carry out taxi transport of passengers for 2021. Coverage: Ирина Искрова. The portal shows the English title as "Register of issued taxi passenger authorisations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ирина Искрова. Its keywords include община, РМС 436/2017, разрешения, издадени, Белово, таксиметров превоз. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
